5.diagnosis: Three consecutive DISCARDs on chronological split (Exp 2: 0.5098, Exp 3: 0.5116 with cyclical hours, Exp 4: 0.4960 dropping time_since_signup). Exp 4 is the most informative result yet: removing the adversarial time_since_signup made test AUC WORSE — meaning that despite its train/test direction reversal, time_since_signup was still contributing weak positive signal that offsets the random noise of the other features. The conclusion is that we lack drift-robust signal entirely; the published FDB AFD TFI 0.636 ceiling must come from features we do not compute. AFD TFI is documented to use entity-level aggregations (transaction counts per entity over windows). This experiment introduces train-only frequency and Bayesian-smoothed fraud-rate features for device_id, ip_address, country, source, and browser — the closest open-source equivalent to AFD TFI's velocity features.
5.citations:
Pozzolo, Boracchi, Caelen, Alippi & Bontempi 2018 IEEE-TNNLS 'Credit Card Fraud Detection: A Realistic Modeling and a Novel Learning Strategy' (arXiv:1709.05927) — explicitly recommends entity-aggregation features (transaction counts and fraud-rate target encodings per device/card/IP) as the principal source of drift-robust signal in transaction-fraud detection because they encode the historical prevalence of an entity in the training period rather than a per-transaction property that may shift over time.;
Micci-Barreca 2001 SIGKDD 'A Preprocessing Scheme for High-Cardinality Categorical Attributes in Classification and Prediction Problems' (DOI:10.1145/507533.507538, in KDD Explorations 3-1) — establishes Bayesian-smoothed target encoding (smoothed device fraud-rate per training window) as the canonical approach for high-cardinality categoricals, which motivates our smoothing=5 prior toward the global train fraud rate to handle the 137,956 unique device IDs without overfitting on the 4.5%-fraud singletons.
5.hypothesis: We hypothesize that adding device_id_freq, ip_address_freq, country_freq, source_freq, browser_freq, device_fraud_rate_train, and country_fraud_rate_train will lift test AUC from Exp 3's 0.5116 into the 0.58 to 0.66 range because the mechanism per Pozzolo et al. 2018 is that fraud devices in the test period that were also active in the training period get tagged via their training-time frequency and fraud-rate signature, and unseen test devices (94.8% per the audit) get a freq=0 marker that itself becomes a fraud predictor since cold-start devices skew toward fraud in this dataset.
5.prediction: Test AUC-ROC should land in the range 0.58 to 0.66, matching or approaching FDB's AFD TFI ceiling of 0.636 for the first time. If AUC reaches 0.62-0.66, the velocity-feature hypothesis is validated and the implementation closes the gap with the proprietary AFD TFI; if AUC stays below 0.58, FDB AFD TFI must use additional features (rolling time-windowed counts, IP-geolocation distance, label-timestamp correlation) that we do not compute and the dataset's true ceiling for our feature set is below 0.58.
